name: Freygish clarinet
desc: Klezmer clarinet lead in B freygish (phrygian dominant — the raised third against the flat second): weeping krekhts grace-notes, heavy vibrato, phrases that climb laughing and fall crying, in the Naftule Brandwein wedding tradition. wt_clarinett voice.

code.full: note("<[b4 c5 d#5 ~ e5 d#5 c5 b4] [f#4 ~ a4 g4 ~ f#4 ~ ~] [d#5 e5 f#5 ~ g5 f#5 e5 d#5] [c5 b4 ~ a4 b4 ~ ~ ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_clarinett").vib(6).vibmod(.5).attack(.02).decay(.3).sustain(.35).release(.15).lpf(3800).gain(${gain}).off(1/16, x=>x.add(note(1)).gain(.25)).room(.32).every(8, x=>x.rev()).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: note("<[b4 c5 d#5 e5 f#5 e5 d#5 c5] [b4 d#5 f#5 ~ a5 g5 f#5 e5] [d#5 e5 f#5 g5 a5 g5 f#5 e5] [d#5 c5 b4 a4 g4 f#4 b4 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_clarinett").vib(6.5).vibmod(.55).attack(.015).decay(.25).sustain(.32).release(.12).lpf(4200).gain(${gain}).off(1/16, x=>x.add(note(1)).gain(.3)).ply("<1 1 2 1>").room(.3).lastOf(8, x=>x.rev()).orbit(5).play()
